title: APIFlow-Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Survive Long, Dependent API Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.29128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using agents are commonly evaluated by a single bit: whether an end-to-end workflow completed. This metric fails to distinguish failures that matter in production, such as expired credentials, malformed payloads, or correct execution followed by incorrect final delivery. We introduce APIFlow-Bench, a fully auditable benchmark for long-horizon, dependent REST-API workflows that decomposes performance into seven engineering capabilities and requires agents to produce answers supported by the actual call path. We generate synthetic API worlds forward, subtask by subtask; each subtask is admitted only after a zero-LLM self-test triad verifies its grader and an oracle establishes solvability, and an adversarial audit identified and fixed six grader exploits. translated_title: APIFlow-Bench：衡量智能体能否在长程、有依赖的API工作流中存活
translated_abstract: 使用工具的智能体通常仅用一个比特来评估：端到端工作流是否完成。这一指标无法区分生产环境中真正重要的失败，例如凭证过期、载荷格式错误，或执行正确但最终交付错误。我们提出APIFlow-Bench，这是一个完全可审计的基准，面向长程、有依赖的REST-API工作流，它将性能分解为七项工程能力，并要求智能体给出由实际调用路径所支撑的答案。我们逐个子任务地前向生成合成API世界；每个子任务只有在零LLM自测三重验证确认其评分器无误、且参考求解器（oracle）确立其可解性之后才被采纳；对抗性审计识别并修复了六个评分器漏洞。评分是确定性的且对来源敏感：状态检查会追踪一个由模拟环境铸造的金丝雀标记穿过API数据流，直达答案必须源自的那个响应，并采用类型化的答案……
tldr: APIFlow-Bench是一个完全可审计的长程REST-API工作流基准，它将智能体性能分解为七项工程能力，并通过确定性、来源敏感的评分机制（包括追踪数据流金丝雀标记）来区分生产环境中真实存在的各类失败模式。
en_tdlr: APIFlow-Bench is a fully auditable benchmark for long-horizon, dependent REST-API workflows that decomposes agent performance into seven engineering capabilities and uses deterministic, provenance-sensitive grading to distinguish real production failure modes.
